Episode 138. White Night Tower Keeper (1)
Creak.
The sound of Hedo lighting his cigarette was heard.
The arena, which had been noisy with the fierce clash of swords and magic, quieted down in an instant.
It was as if it was only natural for this muscular giant to appear on the scene.
An overwhelming sense of pressure.
There was no more accurate and simple way to describe Hedo, the man.
Just by blocking the entrance, the arena seemed to have become a sealed room with no exit, and the air turned heavy like mud, making it difficult to breathe.
What is that monster...? And whose head is that?
The Runcandels exchanged glances.
Even though the Phantom Legion members knew who he was, they were exchanging glances as well.
However, unlike the Runcandels, the Phantom Legion's glances carried these emotions:
Bewilderment, grief, shock.
And fear.
The reason for these emotions was none other than the fact that the head Hedo had dropped belonged to one of their fellow Phantom Legion members.
'Hedo killed Röv!'
'Damn it, I came back to the tower just in case something like this would happen...!'
Of course, the Phantom Legion's emotions were not communicated to the Runcandels, who had been clashing fiercely just moments ago.

Their faces were hidden by their hoods, and the Phantom Legion was not a loose group that would expose their emotions to their enemies, no matter how dire the situation. They were the elite of the elite.
However, those who had been selected since birth and had gone through terrible efforts and education to don the gray robes of the Phantom knew even better because they were so strong.
Sometimes there are untouchable monsters in the world, and there are other mountains and skies above the mountains.
Just as those few extraordinary individuals they had encountered while living as Phantom Legion members, just like that man right there!
Crackling!
The long leaf cigarette burned rapidly like a fuse. The thick ashes did not flutter but clumped and fell in chunks. In a single puff, the leaf cigarette turned entirely into ashes.
Whoosh!
Then, as Hedo exhaled the smoke he had collected in his lungs, the rather poisonous and fierce smoke veiled his robust upper body.
"Haah?"
It was Murakan who broke the silence.
He tried to make a face that was as menacing as possible, but without losing his composure or appearing impatient.

"Who are you, punk? Without even knocking. Let me see your buff body, did you come from a bodybuilding competition? If you don't want to get beaten to death, pretend you didn't see me and go on your way."
Then, subtly poking Jin's side, he whispered:
'Kid, we need to run.'
Jin intuitively felt it.
The four Phantom Legion members were strong opponents, but they were manageable with the current strength of the Runcandels.
However, that unidentified warrior was beyond their capabilities.
Even with himself, Diphus, Joshua, and the Black Knight, who had recovered half of their strength, along with Murakan.
It was definitely not Genesis. The Runcandels and Murakan, who had experienced the majesty of the Genesis Knights up close, were certain of it.
But even if it wasn't Genesis, it was definitely somewhere nearby...
A giant standing tall in the realm of such extraordinary warriors.
'I've never heard of such an incredible warrior existing in Zipfel. Could it be, Kinzelo?'

Not only Jin, but Joshua, Diphus, and the Black Knight also didn't know Hedo's identity. There was no mention of Hedo in the secret Zipfel power list document that the Black Knight and top knights could read.
Crunch!
Hedo crushed the head of the dead Phantom Legion member under his foot and spoke. The Phantom Legion members didn't dare open their mouths at the sight.
"Knocking? As the second-ranking steward of Zipfel, I never considered that, Black Dragon. Isn't this not the territory of the Runcandels?"
He thought Murakan was the Black Dragon?
The Phantom Legion members realized their mistake when Hedo said that.
It wasn't that they hadn't considered it, but they thought the possibility of him being the Black Knight was higher since he was wearing a mask.
"Eh? My mask isn't torn, how did you recognize me?"

"Everyone knows that the Black Dragon prefers to use rather crude language. The one holding a greatsword is a fourth-generation knight, the one holding the black sword Kainer painted to look like an ordinary chunk of iron is a second-generation knight, and that friend seems to be Black Knight Jane. Lastly, the twelfth-generation Jin Runcandel."

Having their identities exposed was not surprising since it would have been a matter of time even if they had only fought the Phantom Legion. The infiltration uniforms were worn in the first place to minimize unnecessary exposure.
However, they couldn't help but be dumbfounded by the introduction of the second-ranking steward.
Such a person being merely a second-ranking steward was far beyond common sense.
Also, the 'steward list' of Zipfel was not only available to the Runcandels without having to read their confidential intelligence documents, but it had also been public knowledge for a long time.
Not only Zipfel, but the steward information of the Runcandels, the royal family, and other prominent families and factions was generally not confidential.
Stewards not only handled the internal and external affairs of their families but were also responsible for many external tasks.
Negotiations, welcoming guests, banquets, various events, and so on. The media tends to report on such things, and the names of the butlers who handled the related tasks are often mentioned.
'The known second-ranked butler is Melvin Grouch. Grouch is known as the best brain. But that monster is a second-ranked butler?'
If Hedo's words are not lies, he must be in that position 'because he wants to' for some reason. The group all thought so.
"Second-ranked butler? Hey, Mr. Physique. You're just a second-ranked butler?"
"Well... I do perform several other duties as well. One of them is the role of the guardian of this tower."
"Tower guardian?"
"Yes. It would be better to formally introduce myself again. I am Hedo, the Tower Guardian of White Night."
Hedo, bowing with a line drawn on the inside of his body with his right arm.
The Tower Guardian of White Night.
Having revealed another title, Hedo was subtly observing Jin.
'Jin Runcandel...'
The 12th flagbearer of Runcandel, whom his mistress, Sandra Jipple, had "decided to love."
Although he was generally indifferent to external affairs, he had occasionally felt a very small curiosity since Sandra began to make a fuss about love and marriage.
What kind of person is he that makes the world so noisy? It is the first time since Luna that a Runcandel generation has attracted so much attention.
However, if it weren't for Sandra, Hedo would not have been more interested in Jin at this moment.
"Can you take off your mask?"
"No."
"Although we belong to opposing families, I have revealed who I am with full courtesy on this side. It doesn't seem like a difficult request."

"I appreciate that you revealed your alias and title, Warrior. However, a Runcandel swordsman cannot comply with the request of a Jipple butler. Reveal your real name and location. Then, I will take off the mask."
"Boldness is tolerable, 12th flagbearer. As you wish."
Swoosh.
Hedo slowly drew the longsword tied to his waist. It was twice as long and thick as a typical longsword, but not as blunt as to be called a greatsword, having a sleek shape.
For a moment, Murakan hesitated at the sight of the sword.
"However, you must understand that my mercy is diminished accordingly."
Whoosh!
A sharp, piercing sound, like a needle stabbing the eardrum, engulfed the room.
It was the result of Hedo stepping forward and making a single strike. How could such a massive body move so quickly? The group could not believe their eyes even after witnessing it.
Moreover, the sword's energy did not only go in one direction.
Although the side he swung was in the center, the sword energy formed a massive fan shape covering Hedo's entire front.
A single strike, but hundreds of sword energies.
It was the realm of "Sword Wave," a legend passed down from mouth to mouth among warriors. The sword energies, spreading like waves, indiscriminately attacked the air, objects, and people.
The Rune Knights gathered their energy, raised protective shields, and wielded their best swordsmanship to withstand Hedo's strike.
It was terrifying.
Everyone who received the attack felt the same way. Moreover, the Rune Knights couldn't help but wonder one thing, separate from the shock.
'If he attacks like this, won't the wandering spirits also be affected?'

Hedo's sword energies threatened not only the Rune Knights but also the wandering spirits. In fact, it seemed that especially strong sword energies were pouring towards the wandering spirits rather than the Rune Knights.
Although Jin and his party couldn't yet deduce the reason, one thing was certain.
Within the Zipfel family, Hedo held a position where he could trample even the wandering spirits at will.
'Is this Hedo character wielding at least the same power as Octavia Zipfel? No, there are a few strange points that make me think otherwise...'
Jin felt that the wandering spirits' attitudes were somewhat strange.
'If Hedo, as a superior, is scolding the wandering spirits for some reason, they should have apologized first. But they seem to have no choice but to withstand Hedo's attack... Ugh!'
Screech-!
Hedo's longsword, which had approached Jin unnoticed, dropped onto Jin's forehead.
It had been a long time since he'd felt like his wrist would break from merely blocking a sword.
Before Hedo could retrieve his sword, Murakan and Diphus swung their swords and fists at him, while Joshua and Jane tried to attack from the side.

And just as the Rune Knights' attacks were about to connect, Hedo's muscles swelled, and in the next moment, the party had to mistake that their swords and fists had pierced and struck not human flesh but some indescribably hard mineral.
Their swords and fists were repelled.
The desperate attacks of the two top-ranked knights and the Black Knight, as well as Murakan, who had regained 50% of his strength, had all been deflected.
Everyone was shocked, but Murakan, in particular, had his eyes wide open.
While the other Rune Knights couldn't take their eyes off Hedo's astonishing physique, Murakan was examining his unusually long sword.
It was as if something had come to mind.
"You... Where did you get that sword?"
Murakan asked in a low voice. He seemed confused.
Hedo tilted his head slightly.
"You ask a strange question, Black Dragon. Also, from what I've heard from those who experienced your martial arts in the Gaipa Army, your level was not like this."
Behind the mask, Murakan's eyes, fixed on Hedo's longsword, were trembling.
"Ah, if you're worried about revealing all your power and inviting support from your family, you don't have to worry. There's no way support from your family will come here."
